actions.description: Initial qualified SMC-manufactured chips become commercially available in the alternate timeline. This begins staged availability, not guaranteed release of every chip or mature yields; video RAM retains a separate qualification gate. SMC performs wafer fabrication rather than merely packaging AION dies.

outcomes.description: AION remains the launch supplier for June 1979 cards. Qualified SMC parts become independently purchasable alternatives; no automatic procurement switch, price reduction or high-volume yield is asserted.
